namespace Shop.Application.Services
{
    public class QuoteService
    {
        public decimal Estimate(Quote quote)
        {
            return SumWithDiscount(quote.Lines, quote.CustomerTier);
        }

        private decimal SumWithDiscount(IEnumerable<OrderLine> items, int level)
        {
            decimal result = 0;
            foreach (var item in items)
            {
                var amount = item.Quantity * item.UnitPrice;
                if (level > 2 && amount > 100)
                {
                    amount = amount * 0.9m;
                }
                result += Math.Round(amount, 2);
            }
            return result;
        }
    }
}
